thread:
deploy-bot: kicking off controlled FF rollout for release v2.4.0. Flag: `llmroute.enable_new_batcher`. Initial window: 01:00-03:00 UTC. Staged plan: 0% -> 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100% with 12m observation between steps. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ff-llmroute-v2.4.0 :shipit:

kai: noted. request: pin the llm-router model to avoid mixed-model noise during the 3% and 15% stages. Suggest `deployctl pin service=llm-router version=2026-03-21-1 --scope=canary`.

leah: agreed. i'll prep the pin and a quick KV warmup. Warmup command: 
```
./ops/warm_kv.py --model 2026-03-21-1 --batch 500 --threads 6 --duration 8m
```
run ~8-10m before the 3% step.

diego: rollback triggers I want in the auto-policy: 5m error_rate > 1.0% OR p99 latency delta > 250ms vs baseline OR GPU error_count > 0 for two consecutive checks. On trigger: set flag back to 0% and unpin after stable.

priya: adding monitoring hooks: temp alert p99>baseline+150ms, alert channel #ops-incident, enable 2% trace sampling for canary traffic, and enable `llmroute.debug_logs` for the canary cohort only.

leah: also lowering batcher.batch_timeout_ms to 5ms in the canary region to reduce tail latency noise. config: `service.llm-router.batcher.batch_timeout_ms=5`.

kai: release notes blurb drafted: "Enabled experimental new batcher for llm-route (staged rollout). Pinned llm-router to v2026-03-21-1 for canary. Performed KV warmup prior to canary. Auto-rollback thresholds applied." i'll open the release PR now.

deploy-bot: scheduled rollout id rl-20260321-11. Locking flag for the window to prevent concurrent edits. `deployctl lock ff=llmroute.enable_new_batcher window=01:00-03:00UTC`

ops-bot: preflight checks: smoke-tests=pass, infra-health=green, canary-region-capacity=ok. Runbook link verified.

leah: warmup started in 7m. will post status after completion.

kai: reminder: coordinate with customer-success if this flag impacts A/B cohorts. pinged @cs-team.

leah: warmup done. prefix cache=96%. starting 3% step now.

deploy-bot: applied 3% at 1825001360. observation in progress.

diego: monitoring - initial metrics look stable. small bump in p95 (~40ms) but within expectations. continue.

priya: created temp alerts and tracing. nothing firing so far.

leah: moving to 15% at 1825001420.

deploy-bot: 15% applied. observation window ongoing.

diego: saw a single GPU driver error on one node, flagged as transient. watching; if error_count > 0 again within 2 checks we'll hit rollback.

priya: alerting rule tweaked to require 2 consecutive windows for GPU errors.

kai: if we need to abort fast: `deployctl ff set llmroute.enable_new_batcher=0% --force && deployctl unpin service=llm-router`. post-incident: include links to rollout rl-20260321-11 and PR # (will add).

deploy-bot: continuing rollout. next planned step 50% if no alerts by 1825001480. tagging @kai @leah @diego @priya for final go/no-go.
